title: ACAT Compendium
description: The authored circle of thirteen knowledge domains. No domain is on top: they are ordered by code only. Subdivisions are symmetric where the world is (regions follow UN M49; traditions are siblings, never an 'other' bucket).

title: Kinds of things
description: Facet: what sort of thing something is (person, place, event, practice, work, idea…). Defined for entities and claims; not yet applied to compendium concepts.

title: Epistemic status
description: Facet: how a statement is known. Every claim carries one; the default is 'attributed' (a named source says so; this catalogue has not judged it).

title: UN M49 regions, countries and areas
license: UN Statistics Division public standard (cited, unmodified)
description: Facet: where. The UN statistical view of regions and areas, in the six official UN languages. It is one named perspective on places, not the only one.

title: Universal Decimal Classification (main classes)

title: Dewey Decimal Classification (main classes)
license: DDC is © OCLC; only class numbers and short captions are cited here

title: Propædia — Outline of Knowledge (parts)
description: The ten parts of the Encyclopædia Britannica's Outline of Knowledge (Mortimer Adler, 1974), arranged as a circle with no part on top — the model for the ACAT circle.

title: Wikidata
description: Items and properties referenced by mappings and claims.
